name: Troll Slayer
description: Troll Slayers are members of a morbid Dwarf cult, sworn to atone for some unforgivable shame. With flame-red hair and ritualistic tattoos, they roam in search of the deadliest monsters, seeking redemption in glorious battle.

abilities.name: Indomitable
abilities.text: Each time this fighter is activated, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

abilities.name: Deathwish
abilities.text: When this warrior is targeted by a melee attack action that inflicts enough damage to take this warrior out of action, before it is removed from the battlefield, this warrior makes a free attack action.
